feeds.title: The Hymn Society
feeds.description: Follow along with The Hymn Society as we share with you our latest stories, hymns, personal stories, events, and more.The Hymn Society's members are always creating new music, leading in new ways, and traveling the world to learn and teach.

feeds.title: Common Hymnal Blog
feeds.description: Key topics covered in the articles are songs, stories, ideas, poems and songwriting. Common Hymnal has build a virtual library, a cyber hymnal, to facilitate a vital and ongoing exchange of songs, stories and ideas between the various communities in this space.

feeds.title: Happy Hymnody
feeds.description: Happy Hymnody blog provides a new hymn on the first of every month that we learn together as a community. Happy Hymnody sows the seed of the Gospel into the hearts of our children through family worship, teaching sound doctrine and theology, memorizing theologically solid hymns, psalms and spiritual songs.

feeds.title: Hymns and Books Blog
feeds.description: Hymns and books blog covers key topics like hymns, art, thought, poetry and theology. Andrew Pratt is a hymn writer, poet, author, lecturer, methodist minister

feeds.title: Hymn Studies Blog
feeds.description: A blog devoted to the study of the background, authors, composers, and meaning of hymns.

feeds.title: Hymns With A Message
feeds.description: I am Barry Kauffman, hymns have been and continue to be a real source of inspiration to me. My desire in this blog is to share special hymns with my readers hoping that the words will minister to them, especially in times of great personal need.

feeds.title: Worship Matters
feeds.description: Find resources for music, worship, & more on Worship Matters Blog.Bob Kauflin is a husband, father, pop-pop, director of Sovereign Grace Music, songwriter, pianist, most importantly, redeemed son of God and amazed by grace.

feeds.title: Scripture Songs for Worship
feeds.description: Listen to the best scripture songs suitable for worship, effective for memorizing and meditating the Word of God. Scripture Songs for Worship is dedicated to worshiping YHWH our God with songs written straight out of the Bible.

feeds.title: Church Music
feeds.description: Podcast provides Catholic Liturgical Music. Covers articles on hymns, church music, music for Sunday and mass

feeds.title: Hymns for Worship
feeds.description: Hymns for Worship is a subjective lens on what matters in worship when it comes to music. My goal is to help Seventh-Day Adventist church lay members appreciate serious sacred music, particularly hymns. I also aim to provide online resources to those struggling music coordinators who may not have enough time to attend music seminars but dreams of making it better for their churches.

feeds.title: David's Hymn Blog
feeds.description: Blogging my way through the hymnal Praise for the Lord, with emphasis on devotional study of the texts and occasional forays into armchair musicology.

feeds.title: Hymncharts Blog
feeds.description: Arranger/composer Don Chapman designed HymnCharts for busy musicians and worship leaders who want our rich heritage of hymns to flow smoothly with contemporary worship. Don's passion is for the Church, music and technology, and he blends all three into several resource websites devoted to contemporary worship: HymnCharts.com, WorshipScores.com and WorshipFlow.com.

feeds.title: Ken Puls Music Blog » Hymn
feeds.description: Music and resources for worship. Covers articles on church music, hymn, prayer, songwriting, psalms, worship and spiritual songs.Ken Puls is a follower of Jesus, husband, father, music professor, worship leader, guitarist and songwriter. Ken has composed 70 hymns and songs, including hymns in Psalms, Hymns and Spiritual Songs.

feeds.title: Grace Community Church Hymns
feeds.description: Hymns is a site that has lyrics and piano music for the songs that we at our church during Sunday worship. Listen to the piano instrumental and sing along.

feeds.title: Paul Jernberg Blog
feeds.description: Listen to new worship songs compositions by Paul Jernberg.Paul Jernberg, a composer, conductor and educator, is dedicated to promote the renewal of sacred liturgical music in the Roman Rite of the Catholic Church, in harmony with Church teaching and her great traditions of sacred music.

feeds.title: Village Hymns Blog
feeds.description: Village Hymns serves to develop and support worship leaders to lead thriving ministries.

feeds.title: Word & Wonder » Hymn of the Week
feeds.description: Word & Wonder exists to help families grow in the truth of God's word and the wonder of his love by providing theologically-rich resources for inspiration, education, and transformation.

feeds.title: Great Christian Hymns Blog
feeds.description: Find Christian song lyrics to your favorite hymns, download piano and guitar chords for Christian hymns, choose hymns to use for a wedding ceremony, hymns for adoption ceremony, baby baptism, funeral or memorial hymns, Easter hymns, and more on Great Christian Hymns Blog.

feeds.title: J. Brian Craig
feeds.description: J. Brian Craig is a minister, musician, and artist who loves God and his church. He started this blog to help provide resources and build community among worship leaders and those who love the way music can connect us to God and each other.
